info.title: ScholoNix Multi-Tenant School Management SaaS API
info.description: Authoritative REST API specification covering Health Probes, Authentication & Onboarding OTP, School Admissions & Fee Ledgers, the Student Management Suite (Enrolment, Promotion, Transfer, Groups, Settings, CSV/PDF Exports), and Company Admin Governance (backed by PostgreSQL RLS + Upstash Redis).

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Liveness and readiness probes for PostgreSQL, Redis, and app workers

tags.name: Auth & Onboarding
tags.description: School registration, session cookies, OTP verification, and password reset

tags.name: School Workspace
tags.description: Tenant dashboard overview and school context endpoints

tags.name: Admissions & Fees
tags.description: Enquiries, admission applications, documents, reminders, admitted roster, and fee ledgers

tags.name: Student Management
tags.description: Student roster, profile dossiers, academic year promotion, TC transfers, bulk operations, groups, and CSV import/export

tags.name: Platform Admin
tags.description: Company Super Admin / Operations APIs cached via Upstash Redis across all schools

tags.name: Platform Auth
tags.description: Company Admin login, TOTP MFA, passkey/WebAuthn, and password security

tags.name: Public & Feedback
tags.description: Public contact inquiries and in-portal feedback submission
